meta_description: City Keys Birmingham — rapid emergency locksmith services across the city. 24/7 callouts, fast response times. Call now for lockouts, repairs and key cutting.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out? We're On The Way
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or car in Birmingham? We arrive fast and get you back inside — day or night, no matter the time.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to lock repairs, key cutting, and security upgrades — we handle it all quickly and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, flat, or car? We arrive within 30 minutes and open most locks without damage. No call-out charge for genuine lockouts.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Worn locks, broken keys, or damaged cylinders? We repair on the spot or fit new high-security locks to keep your property safe.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Lost your keys or need spares? We cut new keys while you wait — from house and car keys to specialist profile keys.

services.title: Broken Key Extraction
services.desc: Key snapped in the lock? We carefully remove the broken piece and create a replacement, restoring your access fast.

services.title: Burglary Repairs & Upgrades
services.desc: After a break-in, we assess damage and install new locks and security upgrades to prevent future break-ins.

services.title: Commercial Lock Services
services.desc: Office lockouts, master key systems, and security door installation for Birmingham businesses — same rapid response.

about_pullquote: I started City Keys because I hated waiting hours for a locksmith when I was locked out myself.
about_para_1: City Keys was founded over eight years ago by a locksmith frustrated with slow response times and overpriced callouts across Birmingham. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted emergency service, handling thousands of lockouts, repairs, and key cuts every year. We still operate the same way — honest pricing, fast arrivals, and a focus on solving your problem without fuss.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we're genuinely quick, we don't charge inflated prices, and we treat every job seriously — whether it's a midnight lockout or a routine key cutting. Word-of-mouth and repeat customers make up most of our work, which tells us we're getting it right. We're based in Edgbaston and cover all of Birmingham, from Sutton Coldfield to Solihull.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About City Keys

reviews.text: Got locked out of my flat on a Sunday evening and called City Keys in a panic. They arrived in 25 minutes and had the door open in minutes. Really professional and the price was fair — no hidden charges. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a key snap in my car lock and didn't know what to do. The guy came out same day, removed the broken bit, and cut me a new key. Sorted in under an hour. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Called them at 2am after a break-in. They were round within 45 minutes, fitted new locks, and made the place secure again. Excellent service when we needed it most. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David K.
